question: Does every selected token-efficiency tool run inside Ultracode workflow subagents on this host, and what do the tools' own counters and an exact tokenizer show?
method: One Sonnet 5 workflow subagent per tool did real work on this repository (disposable worktree at origin/main f5812d3f, or the session project root where a tool is bound to it). It wrote the plain baseline only by shell redirect, read only the tool's output, and ran a deterministic check of its answer against the baseline.

Upstream lifetime counters (rtk gain, headroom savings, jCodeMunch get_session_stats, Context Mode stats) and ccusage were captured immediately before and after the workflows with tools/token-report/token_manifest.py refresh plus raw copies.
Each baseline/tool-output pair was compared exactly with token_manifest.py compare (o200k_base via gpt-tokenizer 3.4.0) and recorded in the private token-report ledger.
Provider consumption of every child comes from examples/claude-native/workflows/child-usage.mjs over the workflow transcripts.
